name: Ahes Cornwall
original_name: アーエス・カーニュエール
source:
Their enemy, Ahes is an aggressive and persistent foe who assaults Yuuma and gang. Cute but misguided. Very much like a normal girl. Has the ability to shoot lightning bolts, but she prefers to use weapons up close and personal.

[Edited from Accany Wordpress]
